Both Sophia and Merazophis reason that Ariel is truly helping them out of own accord heart, though, due to how petty she is with White; constantly goading her due to their complicated relationship and the grudge she has against White for killing so many of her close kin. It can be reasoned that Ariel does not reveal her true motives easily, but is actually a kind and caring individual to those she considers family or friends.[2] She is even willing to be the guardian of these children, comparatively speaking, struggling with their emotions. She has a strong sense of responsibility, clearly stating that an adult is the one that is needed to explain to children the correct choices in any given situation and why those choices are the correct ones.

On the other side of the coin, she is absolutely ruthless towards her enemies, offering no sympathy whatsoever, and completely devouring everything that stands in her way. In her battle with Kumoko, before Mother's death, Ariel didn't hesitate to completely obliterate Kumoko once she understood that they were enemies. She is also a cold-hearted schemer, even after merging with Body-Brain. Befriending Sophia and Merazophis was only a calculated plot to make White lower her guard, at least initially. She still fully intended to backstab and kill White while traveling with them to get revenge for the Queen Taratect. Even giving Kumoko the nickname "White" was simply an attempt to mind control her through the "Naming" skill. Ariel only truly gave up on killing White after her meeting with Dustin, where she finally accepted that revenge is out of reach.

Over the course of their travels together, Ariel eventually parts ways with her grudge against White, indicating that she is a rather forgiving person as well. White often refers to her as a true saint, one who automatically thinks about the well-being of others before themselves. This is mentioned when Ariel decides to save Sael from the tank in the hidden underground facility.

Powers

Ariel is the most powerful being within the confines of the System, rivaled and surpassed only by Gods, with all her stats being nearly maxed. Her primary fighting style appears to simply revolve around overpowering her opponents through brute force. Furthermore, being the progenitor of the taratect species allows her to summon any of her kin to her side whenever she pleases, giving her enough firepower to take on the whole of humanity by herself. Kumoko describes Ariel's strength as “genre-breaking”, comparing her to characters from “some power-creeper shōnen”.

Titles & Skills
Gluttony: Her signature move: it allows her to consume anything, from earth, to metal, to living beings, and turn it into sustenance and power that further increases her already nearly maxed stats over the System limit. All she needs to do to activate it is clamping her teeth together and any target in her line of sight is automatically consumed, allowing her to also use it offensively.
Humility: Gained after absorbing Kumoko's “Body-Brain” Parallel Mind; it allows her to go past the limits of the System, effectively granting her power on-par with a god. However, since she is not a god, usage of it places a heavy burden on her soul, lowering her lifespan and leaving her in a permanently weakened state afterward.
Precise Magic Power Operation: Allows her to perceive and control Magic Power better than the regular Magic Power Operation.
Abyss Magic: A dangerous form of magic capable of killing even immortals by converting anything in its radius into pure MA Energy and feeding it to the System. Even she has trouble controlling it, needing a short interval to cast it.
Kin Domination: As the progenitor of the entire Taratect species, she can mentally exert her influence over any of her descendants.
Summoning: Allows her to teleport any Taratect to her side from anywhere in the world.
Marionette Threads: Combines multiple high-level thread Skills, such as Divine Thread Weaving, Thread Genius, and Thread Control, to produce threat from her fingertips and control it. She mostly uses it to restrain her opponents and control others' movements as if they were puppets.
Other Abilities
Stats: As a result of all of her stats being nearly maxed out, Ariel is capable of killing nearly any opponent in one shot. Her strength is so great that she can create shockwaves just by swiping her arms, and she is fast enough that by the time Kumoko detected her, she was already right next to her. Shiraori even claimed that Ariel could destroy an entire town just by sneezing.
Intelligence: Being one of the oldest beings on the planet, Ariel has an unimaginable amount of experience in both battle and politics. She also has great deductive abilities, being able to figure out the mechanics of Shiro's Egg Revival from just a few hints.
Polyglot: Ariel is fluent with both human and demon language. After absorbing Kumoko's “Body-Brain” Parallel Mind, she became capable of speaking Japanese.
Immortality/Longevity: Ariel was stated to naturally possess a level of longevity or even immortality. Even Potimas was unsure of how it happened or how it was made possible, but Ariel's body possess the longevity that possibly surpasses that of an Elf, this is seen where Ariel had never physically aged beyond the physical appearance of a teenager, even before the System was implemented. Potimas himself has never been able to decipher, nor replicate this ability, despite studying and researching it for hundreds of years.

entries.name: WRATH
entries.content:
On Earth, Kyouya was a self-righteous, kind high school boy who could not stand bullies, often standing up to them for his own view of what is "right," even if it resulted in violence. He was nicknamed "little ogre" by his peers in junior-high due to his constant use of violence and small stature. In high-school he was able to endure minor bullying of others and become friends with Shunsuke and Kanata, often playing games with them together.[5] After being reincarnated as a goblin, he was getting comfortable with his new life when disaster struck and he went through many hardships, to the point that his personality and worldview completely changed.

During his enslavement under Buirimus, Kyouya went through inhumane treatment and was forced to constantly make weapons using his unique skill, all while seething in fury towards his captors.[6] He eventually reaches a threshold of rage, resulting in him changing his name to Wrath, the name of the ruler skill that he gained as a result of holding onto his rage for years on end.[7] It takes a long time for him to regain his composure with the help of Shiraori, Ariel, and Sophia.

During the effects of the Wrath skill he will turn into a furious rampaging monster, abandoning common sense and the ability to control his actions. He describes it as becoming a bystander in his own body. As a benefit, though, the Ruler Skill Wrath raises the user's stats and abilities to the absolute highest values allowed by the System,[8] surpassing even Ariel.[9] He tries as much as possible to refrain from using this skill, as he is unable to regain control without intervention from outside.

When Wrath is under control, he usually has a calm and composed attitude; he always keeps an open mind during conversation and remains empathetic to others' situations, even still, he does not waver in his own world view. He also commands a powerful presence, forcing others to acknowledge him with little effort. Shun describes him as an unstoppable blade when they are first reunited.[10] Unlike when he was Kyouya, he knows that sacrifices are unavoidable to achieve his goals.

Powers

As an oni, a high evolution stage for a goblin, Wrath exhibits incredible feats of endurance and strength in battle. Furthermore, being forced to pick the Goblin Shaman at early stage of his life, Wrath has a large pool of MP, allowing him to use magic to amplify his attacks in combat and summon a large arsenal of magic swords which he is able to throw at great distance to cause chaos and destruction when the swords explodes. Having undergo training from the Demon Realm military and experience battles as an army commander, Wrath is a very competent fighter.

Appraisal Stone [Level 8] a magic stone allowing its user to use Appraisal level 8 , originally belonging to the summoner knight Buirimus. Wrath normally has the stone hang around his neck on a string.
Thunder Katana Seiryuu: Offensive Ability 3000, Durability 9978, Special: Divine protection, Thunder attribute attack addition, Automatic repair, Automatic recovery, Magic storage: The sword created by Weapon creation.
Flame Katana Suzaku: Offensive Ability 3000, Durability 9973, Special: Divine protection, Fire attribute attack addition, Automatic repair, Automatic recovery, Magic storage: The sword created by Weapon creation.
Exploding Sword: Offensive Ability 2500, Durability 100, Special: Fire attribute attack addition, Self-destruction, Flying sword: The sword created by Weapon creation.
Titles & Skills
Weapon Creation: His unique skill as a reincarnation, it allows him to craft weapons from nothing using MP. The weapons' quality depends on his skill level and the MP consumed. Also, he is only able to make items that constitute as weapons.
Wondrous Weapon Creation: The evolved from of Weapon Creation; it allows him to give special effects to the weapons he crafts, effectively making them magic weapons.
Naming: Allows him to name an object or individual, raising the target's status values.
Sword God: The extremity of the sword. The maximum correction is applied to movements when using the sword.
Space Magic: Wrath uses his Space Magic to store many of his swords in a pocket dimension. When in battle and in need of long range attacks, Wrath has shown the capability to unleash a barrage of swords at the enemies by summoning his stored blades and then using propulsion magic to fire them. The overall destructive power combined with his explosive swords has been compared to him literally having portable missiles at his beck and call.
Dragon power: Increases status and grants the user the ability to obstruct their opponent's magic making magical damage Insignificant.
Jinx: By touching the opponent he steals HP, MP and SP using the curse attribute.
Wrath: Unlocked after he snapped with anger following years of psychological abuse under Buirimus; while active, it raises his base stats ten-fold, but also makes him go into a blind rage and attack everyone in sight whilst maintaining only a vague sense of consciousness. Upon reaching Heresy Nullification it became possible for him to keep his sanity for a bit after activating Wrath allowing him to fight by turning the skill on at opportune times.

entries.name: SOPHIA
entries.content:
Sophia is pretty dense in certain situations but has no qualms about using her power to muscle through them if she can. Her nature as a Vampire causes her to lust for a battle that can challenge her, but she is denied that by intense training that has made her overwhelmingly more powerful than almost everything within the System. This causes her to lapse into depravity or depression when she focuses too much on it.

Her previous identity of Negishi Shouko was a target of ridicule; consequently, she has an intense dislike for anyone who insists on using her original name. This is also the root of her jealousy towards Shiraori, whom she believes is Wakaba Hiiro, the beauty queen of the class in their previous life. This jealousy makes it easy for her to obtain the title Ruler of Envy and the skill Envy.

Because of the poor treatment she was subjected to back in her previous life, she was firmly convinced that good looks meant everything, a belief she initially carried on in her next life. It was only after Ariel scolded her for being hostile to Shiraori despite owing her for saving her life numerous times did Sophia realize how ugly she was on the inside, and strived to become a better person.

After reincarnating, Sophia has shown to have developed a level of disgust and contempt for her former life and identity due to her previous appearance and the subsequent bullying she went through that lead her to become a social outcast and expressed a desire to put it behind her. Due to this, Sophia has repeatedly shown hostility, annoyance, and even anger to those who persistently refer to her using her old name and identity, this is seen where she showed active contempt for both Oka and Hugo, who repeatedly insisted on referring her by her old name and in the latter's case, her hated nickname. Sophia herself has shown not to be above killing or attacking them if they continue to ignore her insistence to stop using her old name and arising her temper.

After many years of continuous abuse that did not stop despite having separated from Shiro, Sophia developed a kind of masochism or dependency on this abuse which she mistakes for attention, going so far as to ask Shiro why she has not beaten her up so long.

Powers

Unlike most reincarnates, Sophia does not possess a unique skill. Instead, her reincarnation bonus is being a Progenitor Vampire, one of the strongest types of monsters. On top of this, she underwent years of hellish training under Shiro and Ariel, which molded her into one of the most powerful beings within the System. By the time of the prolepsis, she is capable of defeating S-Rank Monsters in a single hit, causing Shun to outright call her “overpowered”.

Equipment
Broadsword: Made from the claw of a legendary-class monster, Fenrir, it is a single edged broadsword around 1.5 m long with a jagged backside. After subduing Wrath, Guliedistodiez infuses a scale from Nia, the strongest ice dragon, into the weapon as a gift. Now, the sword is infused with powerful ice properties that compliment Sophia's own skills really well.[7]
Titles & Skills
Vampire: Her bonus skill as a reincarnation; it changes her race to vampire, granting her enhanced stats along with the following skills:
Progenitor: As a pure-blood she has none of the weaknesses of being a vampire, being able to go out into the sun and not needing to regularly drink blood.
Blood Sucking: Allows her to suck another's blood to regain MP and SP, as well as temporarily gain some of the target's skills.
Shape-Shifting Allows her to transform into any of her familiars; like a bat.
Kin Control: Grants her control over her familiars and anyone she turned into a vampire.
HP Auto-Recovery: Restores HP naturally over time.
Undying Body: Allows her to survive any attack with 1 HP remaining once per day.
Undying King: Raises nearby corpses as zombies under her command. Said zombies won't stop moving unless their bodies are destroyed, and also don't give any experience.[9]
n%I=W: A unique skill shared by all reincarnations; it restores her HP, MP, and SP upon leveling up. However, once the user's level reaches a certain point, it will no longer be able fully recover her stats.[10], though the exact limit is unknown.
Magic Power Perception & Magic Power Operation: Allows her to perceive and control magic power to cast spells.
Water Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate water freely.
Acid Control: A combination of Water Magic, Acid Attack, and Blood Control; it allows her to produce and telepathically control a red fluid that melts everything it touches.
Ice Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate Ice freely.
Magic Resistance: Due to her vampire heritage, along with her specialized training, Sophia can cancel any low to mid-level magic the moment she contacts it.
Wind Resistance: Cancels any wind magic directed at her.
Light Resistance: Cancels any light magic directed at her.
Foul Feeder: Acquired when Shiro had her eat poisoned food; grants poison resistance.
Divine Dragon Barrier: Weakens magic in her surroundings, nullifying any low to mid-level magic.
Envy: Allows her to turn off any skill and System magic that she can perceive. However, repeated usage will cause her to be overcome with overwhelming envy.
Divine Scales: Gained along with Envy; allows her to harden any part of the body with a silver scales.
Other Abilities
Stats: Sophia's stats have been pushed to the limit of what is possible using proficiency through years of exercise. According to Ariel, she could kill Wrath in a single hit while his namesake skill is inactive.
Enhanced Smell: As a vampire, she has an enhanced sense of smell, particularly towards blood.
Intelligence: Despite her childish personality, Sophia is actually smart, capable of coming up with new strategies and finding what abilities synergize best with her build. Furthermore, she also possesses a large amount of combat experience, being able to repeatedly outwit Shun's entire party with ease.

entries.name: FILIMØS
entries.content:
Even before the reincarnation, Okazaki-sensei (Filimos) was known for her weird manner of speech, the same she still uses after the reincarnation. Being a teacher was her childhood dream, and to achieve that she searched for things that were popular among the students (video games, manga, etc.) and created a likeable character for herself based on that. Filimos deeply cares for her students, and even after reincarnation, she works hard to keep them safe. This is seen where she greatly lamented their safety in their new situation, this is seen where she was greatly distressed upon seeing their potential deaths using her bonus skill [Student Roster].

As seen in her inner thoughts, Oka has admitted to not being that strong of a person and was unable to completely abandon her previous life and start over anew in her new one. She kept insisting on her previous identity as a teacher and prioritized the safety of her students above all other factors. Furthermore, with the negative impacts of her unique skill's ability to see the potential deaths of her students, she took the responsibility for them and their wellbeing on herself. Unconsciously due to the above stated reasons, she thought that only she knows what is best for them regardless of their choices and free will. This is seen in her approach to have the elves collect the reincarnated students and forcibly confine them in the Elf Village, at a young age where they could not do anything about it. Justifying that she is in the right and that it was better than leaving them to care for themselves in the hazards of the new world.

Later, as seen in the cases of Sophia and Wrath, Oka has also shown that she was unable or unwilling to even attempt to understand their reasoning for refusing her offer of “protection”. Though it should be noted that she was being influenced by the Elves to make it harder for her to understand their reasoning for reject ing her offer. As presented in the method she used to “help” Hugo regain his “humanity”, Oka herself tends to acts on based on what she thinks is right without really trying to understand the situation. Which can be noted by her believing that removing his skills and stats would have a positive effect on his mind, despite knowing of his personality both before and after reincarnation and was latter baffled and surprised by her actions instead worsening his issues.

Due to the elves having raised her, Oka also possess a level of ingrained antagonism towards the Administrators through her indoctrination since reincarnation. Albeit, due to her already having a fully developed mind and having doubts about the elves, Oka's own hostility is much smaller and she herself doubts the truthfulness of the elves beliefs.

However, due to her inability and refusal to understand the reasoning of Wrath and Sophia to assist the Administrators. Oka herself regards them with hostility, due to her likely unconscious desire to validate her actions as good and being in the right when she was working with the elves.

After the Elf Village Battle during the conference between reincarnates and learning the truth from Wakaba about Potimas and the Elves. She broke down in tears and started hyperventilating upon realization all her action were all for naught.


As an elf, she ages slower and has a longer lifespan than most humanoid beings. However, this also comes with the danger of her remaining a child longer.

entries.name: HUGO
entries.content:
Hugo Renxandt wasn't always the megalomaniac he is now. Before being reborn, he was generally perceived as the class "king," with a frank, egotistical attitude and not afraid to hide his thoughts. He often took things a bit too far, but was held in check by his friend Issei Sakurazaki, who understood him well. Issei passed away in the new world, and Natsume was left alone as Hugo Renxandt, prince of the Renxandt Empire.

Although he indiscriminately hates Shun due to their incompatible personalities, he was charming enough be the leader of the boys in his previous life. If he had been able to enter university, work in part-time jobs and enter society as an adult, he would likely have experienced a smooth and successful life.

Hugo became warped due to not having anyone around him who understood his circumstances, not having anyone he could trust due to the troublesome political situation inside the Empire, and not having had any dissatisfaction about how he had lived his previous life.

As it stands, much of the same happened in the new world when Shun and him came face to face. Hugo had finally found his peers from his previous life, only to find that Shun was the center of attention among them, and so Hugo's hatred never changed, and he was left alone to fend for himself in his despair. The true turning point for Hugo's decent into madness was being driven into a corner and abandoned by his old teacher Okazaki Kanami, now known as Filimos.

At the time when he first met Shun after reincarnating, if he hadn’t tried to avoid Shun due to being aware that they didn’t get along in their previous lives, and if his hard-to-understand SOS had been noticed, perhaps the end result could also have been different.

entries.name: YURI
entries.content:
Due to unfortunate circumstances, Yuri was abandoned to the Church in Alleius to be raised. All alone and scared, Yuri developed a warped personality and became a religious fanatic, believing entirely in the Word of God religion. She often tries to force other people to believe the same things as feverishly as she does, and any slight against her faith is also a slight on her.

She does not understand how anyone could not believe in the Word of God, and so does not take any social cues that other people do not want to talk about her faith. She is also overzealous about people who become enemies of the Word of God, often going straight for the "execution" route.

As seen in the flashbacks, in her previous life before reincarnating, Yuika had a much more normal personality. As seen during her time in school, she was also one of the more considerate and understanding people of her class, this is seen where she was one of the few who believed that Natsume wasn't that bad of a person and thought that there was more to him than his arrogant, surface demeanor.

Power

As a saint candidate for the Word of God Religion and later, saint for Hugo when he was announced to be the next hero, it is expected Yuri is well verse in supportive magic. As all eligible candidates have to undergo for rigorous and strict training from childhood in order to support the next hero.

Titles & Skills
Dreaming Maiden: Yuri's unique skill as a reincarnation; it records her dreams and allows her to create a mini dungeon in subspace based on said dreams, trapping those caught in it until they clear it. However, since the catalyst is a dream, she cannot control the dungeon.[4]
Lightning Magic: Allows her to summon and control lightning.

entries.name: SCHLAIN
entries.content:
Schlain is a kind-hearted, naïve, and overly trusting young man who struggles with guilt and responsibility. He often underestimates his opponents and overestimates his allies, leading to dangerous situations. His naïveté blinds him to negative aspects of his new world, and his stubbornness as a Hero endangers himself and his party.
Schlain’s sheltered life makes him innocent and oblivious to the darker aspects of combat, leading to tactical errors and poor emotional control. He overestimates his party’s ability to defeat stronger opponents and hesitates to kill, even when necessary. After learning harsh truths, he begins to realize his shortcomings and powerlessness.

Power

As a reincarnation, Shun was born with a unique skill, above-average stats, increased proficiency gain that is high even among fellow reincarnates, and innate skill points, causing natives to view him as a prodigy. After acquiring the Hero title, Shiraori regards him as the second strongest human reincarnate after Kunihiko and Asaka and the most powerful as for stats. However, he is held back by his lack of practical battle experience and his stats are still far inferior compared to the classmates reborn as monsters.

Equipment
Hero Sword: A weapon given to him by Leston and previously owned by Julius that serves as his primary weapon. Unbeknownst to him, it is actually an item crafted by D herself that can only be wielded by the current holder of the Hero Title and possesses a one-time-use attack powerful enough to kill even a god.
Titles & Skills
Divine Protection: His unique reincarnation skill; it makes it easier for him to achieve the desired result in any situation. While he himself believes it to be useless, Shiraori considers it “broken” due to how it can interfere with fate itself.
Hero: A unique title only one person in the world might have at a time; grants increased stats, advanced light magic, access to unique items, and special evolutions for his contracted creatures.
Mercy: Allows him to revive the recently deceased as long as their bodies are reasonably intact. However, usage will cause him to acquire the Taboo skill, which will further increase in level with each subsequent usage.
Taboo: Gained following his first usage of Mercy; it increased in level as he commits acts that are considered “taboo”, like reviving the dead. Upon reaching LV10, its effect activated, causing him to learn the truth of the world.
Magic Power Perception & Magic Power Operation: Allows him to perceive and control magic power to cast spells.
Light Magic: Allows him to summon and manipulate light that can burn, pierce, and even vaporize targets; it is noted to his strongest magic affinity and was further boosted upon acquiring the Hero title.
Water Magic: Noted to be his second-strongest magic affinity; it allows him to summon and control water. He is skilled enough with it to put out Hugo's fire magic.
Swordsmanship: he was trained in swordsmanship by Klevea, a former knight, and has even able to put up a fight against Julius, though the latter tried his best to hide this. However, as noted by Sophia, however, due to Schlain's naïveté and inexperience fighting human opponents, his swordsmanship is too “proper” and is practically non-adaptable to unexpected situations, this is seen where he was unable to deal with sneak attacks and other “dirty” tactics an opponent may use against him due to only having experience fighting monsters.
Battle Divinity: Accelerates his motor functions and reflexes using MP; often viewed as essential for combat.
Monster Taming: Allows him to tame and form contracts with monsters. He used it to form a contract with Feirune, though it is noted that he did not actually “tame” her.
Summoning: Allows him to teleport his tamed monsters to his side from anywhere in the world.
Tamed Monsters
Feirune: The reincarnation of one of his classmates, Mirei Shinohara. However, while they share a contract, it has been stated that Shun has not actually “tamed” her.
Other Abilities
Stats: On top of naturally boasting above-average stats due to being a reincarnation, Shun underwent years of traininig by his caretakers, which further raised his strength. As a result, by the time he was a pre-teen, he was already strong enough to where Julius struggled to keep up his facade of not being serious whilst dueling him. After he acquired the Hero titled, Shiraori herself how regards him as the strongest human reincarnation in terms of pure stats.
Intelligence: Despite his dense and naïve nature, Shun is able to read the intentions of his comrades very well, allowing him to easy go along with whatever plan to come up with without any need for words. Both Sophia and Wrath have complimented him for this.
Proficiency Gain: While training with Katia and Fei, it is revealed that Shun's proficiency gain is high even amongst fellow reincarnations, with his stats and skills developing quicker and having lower skill point costs to acquire.

entries.name: POTIMAS
entries.content:
He is a control freak and a narcissist, absolutely obsessed with obtaining Immortality. This obsession has driven all of his actions since before he was 10 years old. It is this diligence towards this goal that earned him the skill Diligence and the title Ruler of Diligence, but also twisted him into a sociopath. He cares not for the living creatures he creates, always throwing them away if he no longer has a use for them or if they become a burden to him.

As noted by Ariel, due to his vindictiveness', stubbornness and immense selfishness, Potimas's overall mentality itself was comparable to nothing more than spoiled child that never grew up. An assessment that was confirmed by Ariel, Dustin and Güliedistodiez after centuries of observing and fighting against him.

Potimas is shown to be supremely self-centered and arrogant and has a habit of constantly overestimating himself and what he is capable off while constantly underestimating his enemies. This is noted to be one of his most prevailing traits and one of his most obvious and major weak points that has been repeatedly exploited by his many enemies' numerous times during their many confrontations against each other.

Abilities
Potimas Harrifenas has extraordinary intelligence, displaying mastery in numerous disciplines, such as biology, engineering and physics. Allowing him to create large number of cyborg clones made using a combination of science and magecraft. A captured clone was found to have been made using magecraft to enhance its hardness and maneuverability, in addition to some small prepared magecraft invocations. These abilities were probably developed using System Skills as the starting point and would have defensive status values of approximately 10,000. The clone was found to be at least 800 years old.

Elf Physiology: Elves have naturally a slow rate of ageing and a longer lifespan than most humanoid beings.
Master Engineer: It was shown in the Web Novel, he was able to create robots that were designed to fight with a god.
Bioengineering: In the past, it was revealed he conducted illegal genetic experiments on people using a new source of energy he discovered and experimented with animal DNA in order to create new hybrid beings to further his goal of learning the secrets of immortality. Potimas himself is the creator of the incredibly long-lived Elf Race and the near immortal Vampire Race. He was also responsible for the creation of the Goblin and Spider Monster Races as well due to their progenitors, Ariel and another unnamed test subject being his personal creations. Potimas himself is also indirectly responsible for the creation of the Demon Race by creating the method of using MA Energy to empower and evolve normal humans. It's also been implied that many of the monsters in the world were created both directly and indirectly by either Potimas or his creations.
Skills & Titles
Despite normally disdaining the System and preferring not to use the powers and abilities offered by it, Potimas has been shown to possess at least a few abilities from the system.

Diligence: Granted due to his fanatic obsession to surpass death; allows him to to freely displace his soul into someone else's body and take over it, effectively allowing him to repeatedly cheat death. However, his original soul remains with his main body, meaning he will die if it is destroyed, and he can only take control of those who possess a piece of his soul, like his Elves and cyborgs.

entries.name: SUELECIA
entries.content:
Sue is extremely attached to Schlain, to the point of completely idolizing him. She developed a romantic interest to him as well as a yandere personality. Making her distrusting of any females of similar age approaching Schlain.

Sue has expressed her intense dislike towards Karnatia ever since her young age. This is due to Schlain and Katia's relationship as best friends in their previous life, which, to Sue, looks like a budding romantic relationship between the two. In the anime, her bitter jealousy with Karnatia is much more tone down.

Sue is considered quite studious both in academics and combat-wise. This likely stems from her emulating Schlain as he studied to learn the language and trained to regain the full use of his body.

Powers & Abilities
Despite being a normal native of the world, Sue's stats rival those of a reincarnation. This likely stems from her emulating Shun's training to regain the full use of his body as a baby, the time when stats grow the fastest. However, unlike her brother, whose stats come partially from being a reincarnation, her abilities are purely the result of her talents, causing him to describe her as a "genuine prodigy".

Titles & Skills
Swordsmanship: She was trained in swordsmanship by Klevea, a former knight, though she never even came close to beating her.
Battle Divinity: Accelerates her motor functions and reflexes using MP; often viewed as essential for combat.
Magic Power Perception & Magic Power Operation: Allows her to perceive a control magic power.
Water Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate water; it is noted to be her strongest magic affinity.
Ice Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate ice. It is noted to be her best magic affinity.
Wind Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate wind.
Light Magic: Allows her to summon and manipulate light that can burn right through a person. She is skilled enough with it for it to be mistaken for Shun's light magic, which is his best affinity, allowing her to frame her brother for her murder of their father.

entries.name: HUGO
entries.content:
Powers

As a reincarnation, Hugo was born with a unique skill and a huge amount of skill points, which was further compounded by him taking full advantage of his gifts. However, Filimos ended up stripping him of his abilities after he misused them, effectively reducing him to a normal native of this world. Despite this, though, he actually ended up becoming even stronger than before after acquiring two Ruler Skills. While his overall build remains unbalanced, he makes up for it using high-grade equipment.

Equipment
Dragon Armor: High-class equipment made from dragon materials that possesses its own set of unique abilities separate from him. After being stripped of his skills and creating an unbalanced skill build from using his [Greed] Skill, he began utilizing it to compensate.
Broadsword: A high-class weapon he wields in combat.
Titles & Skills
n% I = W: A unique skill shared by all reincarnations; it restores his HP, MP, and SP upon leveling up. It also cannot be removed, making it the only skill he kept after Filimos used her Ruler authority on him.
Lust: Acquired from his desire for vengeance after being stripped of his skills; it allows him to brainwash others.
Greed: Acquired from his desire to regain his former strength after being stripped of his skills; it allows him absorb another's stats and skills upon killing them.
Former Titles & Skills
Emperor: His unique skill as a reincarnation until he got stripped of his skills; it inflicted fear onto his opponents whilst also boosting his overall stats.
Fire Magic: Allowed him to summon and control fire; it was his strongest magic affinity until he got stripped of his skills.
Swordmanship: He has shown to fight using a broadsword.
Other Abilities
Influence: As the crown prince of the Renxandt Empire, Hugo enjoys great political influence, allowing him to hire assassins and command the imperial army.
